rows.en: <operator(1060,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Barrel<ce()>... you can do this, right?
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>Of course. But...
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>Worried about <color(5)>Berkt<ce()>?
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>Whether I can kill myself... I don't know.
rows.notes: 'Myself' = Berkt, Barrel's parallel-world counterpart; kept literal per the source's reflexive phrasing.

rows.en: <operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>But... for the sake of the comrades I've fought alongside until now, I have to do it.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>So I'll show you I can do it.
<operator(23010,1)><speed(2)>Once this fight's over, we'll be saying goodbye to everyone, huh.
<operator(10010,1)><speed(2)>We might never see each other again. But that's... a farewell for moving forward.
<operator(17010,1)><speed(2)>Through this fight, each of us found our own future.
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>Passing that on to everyone will be our new fight from here.
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>Let's go... and let's win!
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Faye<ce()>, once this fight's over... will you go back to that other Earth after all?
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>I've never even thought about it. I've fought this far with only one thing in mind - beating <color(5)>Berkt<ce()>.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>Once the <color(6)>Baldora Drive<ce()> closes, we'll never be able to see each other again, huh.
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>Yeah, that's right.
<operator(1040,2)><speed(2)><color(4)>Faye<ce()>... thank you for everything.
<operator(1060,2)><speed(2)>That makes me happy, <color(4)>Barrel<ce()>. But it's too soon for thanks.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>Yeah... let's go!
<operator(1060,2)><speed(2)><color(4)>Barrel<ce()>. You've given me so many things.
<operator(1040,2)><speed(2)>That's not... I didn't know anything, and without <color(4)>Faye<ce()>, I couldn't have fought this far.
<operator(1060,2)><speed(2)>But you faced the fight head-on. You got through it together with your comrades.
<operator(1060,2)><speed(2)>That was an irreplaceable experience for me. I'm truly grateful to <color(4)>Barrel<ce()> for giving me that.
<operator(1060,2)><speed(2)>Thank you, really...
<operator(1040,2)><speed(2)>No thanks until the fight's over, remember?
<operator(1060,2)><speed(2)>You're right... Let's keep counting on each other.
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>...<color(5)>Char<ce()>. The people of Earth you gave up on are trying to protect the world, exactly like this.
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>Even from different worlds, we're standing together like this to protect it. You moved too fast.
rows.notes: 'joining hands' reworded to 'standing together' to avoid the letter j per the style rule.

rows.en: <operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>Sure, there are mistakes. But humanity is what can correct them. I'll prove that people can grow.
<operator(10020,1)><speed(2)>Don't you dare die, <color(4)>Kaine<ce()>.
<operator(10010,2)><speed(2)>Don't say such unlucky things! We're coming back.
<operator(10030,2)><speed(2)>The three of us are a package deal, after all.
rows.notes: 'sanmi ittai' (three-in-one/trinity bond) rendered as 'package deal' - a natural idiom for the three pilots' inseparable bond.

rows.en: <operator(10040,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Kaine Wakaba<ce()>. I...
<operator(10010,2)><speed(2)>Don't say anything. Let's fight for everyone right now!
<operator(10040,1)><speed(2)>Heh... you're right.
<operator(10020,2)><speed(2)>All right, leave this final battle to me!
<operator(10010,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Tapp<ce()>... don't die on me, okay?
<operator(10030,2)><speed(2)>Why so gloomy, <color(4)>Kaine<ce()>? Of course I'm coming back.
<operator(10010,1)><speed(2)>Yeah, you're right... let's go.
<operator(10030,2)><speed(2)>All right, I'll take the final act.
<operator(10020,2)><speed(2)>Don't be stupid. The best part obviously goes to me, the main character!
<operator(10010,2)><speed(2)>With this crew, anyone can carry it! Though I'm still one of a kind, of course.
<operator(10010,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Meio<ce()>... Once this fight's over, I get to be your brother-in-law again, right?
rows.notes: 'Meio' matches the source's short label ('Maiyo' = the character_names_021 ja_short for Meio Plato).

rows.en: <operator(10040,1)><speed(2)>... <color(4)>Kaine<ce()>, I...
<operator(10010,1)><speed(2)>Whoa, save the excuses for after we get back.
<operator(10010,2)><speed(2)>So... make sure you come back.
<operator(10040,1)><speed(2)>Yeah...
<operator(25020,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Isamu<ce()>, don't you die.
<operator(25010,2)><speed(2)>That's rare of you. Worried I'll win and run off on you?
<operator(25020,1)><speed(2)>Don't be stupid. This isn't settled yet.
<operator(25010,1)><speed(2)>No need to worry, I'll wrap this up fast and be right back.
<operator(25010,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Guld<ce()>, after this fight is over...
<operator(25020,1)><speed(2)>The trial continues, huh. I'm winning next time too.
<operator(25010,2)><speed(2)>If you're gonna talk that big... you'd better come back in one piece.
<operator(17070,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Garrod<ce()>. Please come back to me.
<operator(17010,2)><speed(2)>Of course I will.
<operator(17010,2)><speed(2)>I want to find out what future I'm looking for, together with <color(4)>Tiffa<ce()>. You'll stay with me, right?
<operator(17070,1)><speed(2)>I'll... always be with <color(4)>Garrod<ce()>.
<operator(17010,1)><speed(2)>Wait for me, okay.
<operator(17020,2)><speed(2)>Once this fight's over... guess I'll head back to my family.
<operator(17030,1)><speed(2)>You haven't earned nearly enough yet, have you?
<operator(17020,2)><speed(2)>Heh, money doesn't matter to me anymore.
<operator(17020,1)><speed(2)>Everyone... I'll come back alive, no matter what!
<operator(17030,2)><speed(2)>Guess I can't die either. Not until I hear your answer.
<operator(17080,1)><speed(2)>I'm sorry...
<operator(17030,2)><speed(2)>No need to apologize. I'm coming back either way.
<operator(17080,1)><speed(2)>Please... come back alive.
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>Once I'm back on that other Earth, guess it's back to Exodus...
<operator(21020,1)><speed(2)>What's gotten into you? You hated it so much before.
<operator(21030,2)><speed(2)><color(4)>Gainer<ce()> learned that Exodus is a forward-looking word.
<operator(21150,2)><speed(2)>I'm going too!
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>Yeah, that's why I'm definitely coming back!
<operator(21030,1)><speed(2)>You'd better come back, you hear me!
<operator(21020,2)><speed(2)>Well then. Can't let the boys outdo me.
<operator(21020,2)><speed(2)>I want to close this out with <color(4)>Gain Bijou<ce()>'s big moment.
<operator(21020,2)><speed(2)>So, ladies, count on your cheering too.
<operator(12031,1)><speed(2)>I believe <color(4)>Gain<ce()> will be fine.
<operator(1020,1)><speed(2)>Though a little bit of pain might do him some good.
<operator(17080,1)><speed(2)>True enough.
<operator(21020,2)><speed(2)>Hahaha... With cheering like that, there's no way I lose.
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Cynthia<ce()>... come back alive, okay.
<operator(21150,1)><speed(2)>Might not turn out that way, you know.
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Cynthia<ce()>, don't say that...
<operator(21150,1)><speed(2)>A fight isn't a game, is it?
<operator(21150,2)><speed(2)>It's fine. I'll come back anyway. So let's continue the game after.
<operator(23020,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Renton<ce()>. <color(4)>Nirvash<ce()> is cheering us on too.
<operator(23010,1)><speed(2)>Yeah. Let's definitely come back.
<operator(23020,2)><speed(2)>I'm... not afraid of anything as long as I'm with <color(4)>Renton<ce()>!
<operator(23010,1)><speed(2)>Me too. Let's go, <color(4)>Eureka<ce()>.
<operator(23020,2)><speed(2)>Yeah!
<operator(23040,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Holland<ce()>... make sure you come back.
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)>You idiot. Don't state the obvious.
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)>Stop making that face, like I'm going off to die.
<operator(23040,2)><speed(2)>You're right. For the sake of the new life inside me too...
<operator(23230,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Anemone<ce()>, be careful...
<operator(23200,2)><speed(2)>What? Are you saying I'll get taken down?!
<operator(23230,1)><speed(2)>N-no. I only... <color(4)>Anemone<ce()>, I only...
<operator(23200,1)><speed(2)>Kidding, kidding! ...I'll definitely come back to you.
<operator(19020,1)><speed(2)>We entered this fight to defeat the <color(5)>Invaders<ce()>.
rows.notes: 'joined' reworded to 'entered' to avoid the letter j per the style rule.

rows.en: <operator(19010,1)><speed(2)>But our fight isn't over yet. It'll keep going on from here.
<operator(19030,1)><speed(2)>So we never let that tragic history repeat again.
<operator(19020,1)><speed(2)>Let's win this for sure!! And then head into a new fight!
<operator(19040,1)><speed(2)>Gotta end it with this one. Put a stop to our long, long fight.
<operator(19060,1)><speed(2)>Let's put an end here to the fate of those enthralled by Getter Rays too.
<operator(19050,1)><speed(2)>Right... we've learned that Getter Rays are an energy that shows us the future.
<operator(1020,1)><speed(2)>This is the last time... <color(4)>Gun Ark<ce()>, lend me your strength too.
<operator(1020,1)><speed(2)>Just like that time...
<operator(14030,1)><speed(2)>What are you gonna do once this fight's over, <color(4)>Hikaru<ce()>?
<operator(14010,1)><speed(2)>I want to work toward solving the Zentradi issue.
<operator(14010,1)><speed(2)>We managed to understand the Scub too. I'm sure we can do it.
<operator(14030,1)><speed(2)>Yeah... And for that, we're winning this fight, no matter what!
<operator(14010,1)><speed(2)>Please, be sure to save the world from this crisis.
rows.notes: Source addresses Focker only as 'senpai' with no name in the line; per corpus convention (4004673, 4004643) the honorific is dropped without inventing a name.

rows.en: <operator(14030,1)><speed(2)>Hmph. I don't need some grand cause like that.
<operator(14030,1)><speed(2)>I fight for the woman I love. That's reason enough, isn't it!
<operator(6011,1)><speed(2)>Beginning the final mission now.
<operator(6011,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Zero<ce()>... What future will you show me...
<operator(12051,2)><speed(2)>Leave a one-on-one fight to me!
<operator(12061,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Ryoko<ce()>, go get 'em!!
rows.notes: '-chan' dropped per convention of dropping honorifics.

rows.en: <operator(12061,2)><speed(2)>Ugh... Once this fight's over, guess it's back to a life chased by deadlines.
<operator(12071,1)><speed(2)>That kind of peace has its charm too...
<operator(12071,1)><speed(2)>Fighting without thinking about anything... That's all there is to it.
<operator(12061,1)><speed(2)>Haven't seen serious mode in a while. But if that's how it is, we'll be perfectly fine!
<operator(16040,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Asap<ce()>. Please be careful...
<operator(16010,1)><speed(2)>Yeah. I'm fighting here so King <color(5)>Sakomizu<ce()>'s wishes don't go to waste.
<operator(16010,1)><speed(2)>I can't let the death of someone who suffered that much go to waste.
<operator(16040,2)><speed(2)>No, <color(4)>Asap<ce()>. I'm sure Father is smiling right now.
<operator(12121,1)><speed(2)>Even I, who lived as a dog... there's still something I can do.
<operator(12121,1)><speed(2)>One without virtue, drowned in his own delusions... I will cut him down.
rows.notes: Referent of 'him' not named in this row; left as the source leaves it.

rows.en: <operator(12031,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Akito<ce()>...
<operator(12011,1)><speed(2)>It's okay. I'm not going anywhere anymore.
<operator(12031,2)><speed(2)>Yes... I'll be waiting.
<operator(14020,1)><speed(2)>Guess we won't know until we try.
<operator(14130,1)><speed(2)>Listen up, absolutely no butting in!

uncertainties.issue: 'Whether I can kill myself' - source is reflexive (jibun jishin); read as Barrel steeling himself to fight his parallel-world self Berkt, per the established Berkt/Barrel relationship.

'gitei' (giri no otouto) rendered 'brother-in-law'; implies Kaine considers himself already family to Meio through Linda (per Meio's glossary profile), though the two are never shown married/engaged on-page in this corpus.
Trailing, unfinished line ('I just... to Anemone...'); rendered as a fumbled trail-off rather than completing the thought.
'Him' (the one Tsukiomi will cut down) is not named in this row or resolvable from the printed slice; left as the source leaves it, unnamed.

meaning_fixes.before: ...trying to protect the world, just like this.
meaning_fixes.after: ...trying to protect the world, exactly like this.
meaning_fixes.reason: reword to remove lowercase 'j' per style rule; no meaning change.

meaning_fixes.before: Don't say anything. Let's just fight for everyone right now!
meaning_fixes.after: Don't say anything. Let's fight for everyone right now!
meaning_fixes.reason: 'just' dropped (not present in source 'imawa minna no tame ni tatakou ze') to remove lowercase 'j' per style rule; no meaning change.

meaning_fixes.after: N-no. I only... Anemone, I only...
meaning_fixes.reason: reword to remove lowercase 'j' per style rule; keeps the fumbled, unfinished delivery of the source ('boku wa tada Anemone ni...').

meaning_fixes.after: Kidding, kidding! ...I'll definitely come back to you.

meaning_fixes.after: But if that's how it is, we'll be perfectly fine!

checked_decisions: 0/22 'Whether I can kill myself' (reflexive jibun jishin): confirmed as Barrel steeling himself against Berkt, his parallel-world self/rival, consistent with the glossary's Berkt entry and 0/21's 'Worried about Berkt?' lead-in. Accepted, kept literal.
1/219 'gitei' rendered 'brother-in-law': per orchestrator ruling, 'brother-in-law' is fine for 義弟. Accepted as drafted, no change made.

1/460-461, 1/543-461-equivalent n/a; 1/460 'Hikaru Amano-sensei' in-joke: kept as drafted per orchestrator ruling (not reworded despite this being the pre-battle send-off; still the in-joke, not a bare honorific).

1/661 trailing, unfinished line ('boku wa tada Anemone ni...'): kept as a fumbled trail-off, consistent with 1/662's 'Just kidding, just kidding!' response implying Dominic was cut off before finishing a sincere thought. Accepted, not completed.

1/1100 'him' (the one Tsukiomi will cut down): checked against the rest of the scene (rows 1099-1100 are an isolated two-line block with no other Tsukiomi lines before or after in this scene) - the referent is not recoverable from this scene's context. Left unnamed as drafted; carried forward as a remaining uncertainty.
1/1062 'Father' = King Sakomizu, Luxe's own father: confirmed via 1/619 (Asap) and 1/1059-1061 (Luxe/Asap both reference 'King Sakomizu's wishes'); 'Father' reading is consistent and not invented.

Orchestrator decisions: Baldora Drive (0/32) spelled per glossary.json. Ixbrau/New Federation/unidentified life-forms do not appear in this scene. No ship-captain lines in this scene. Speaker tags left unchanged throughout, including the two same-id-different-slot pairs used for paired dialogue (e.g. 1040,1 vs 1040,2 for Barrel).
remaining_uncertainties: 1/1100: the referent of 'him' (the one Tsukiomi will cut down) is not named or resolvable from this scene alone; left unnamed as the source leaves it.

0/22: whether 'kill myself' should read more idiomatically (e.g. 'kill my own self') is a phrasing call, not a meaning error; left as drafted since the reflexive framing (self vs. parallel-world self) is deliberate and documented.
